about: Every admin action, whether it needs a fresh sign-in (ARC-07), what it writes to the audit, and whether it works on a phone, for MP-64. step_up: yes (a story or owner record requires it), no, open (CT-01 decides) or outside (not an MP step-up). No freshness window or assurance level is approved, and no audit vocabulary (CT-03). phone: live or off. The owner, 4 November 2026: "Under Settings, phones read only", from an option that read "Changes happen on iPad or desktop; phones can read and acknowledge", and "Yes, recovery only (Recommended)", to a question about revoking a lost device and enrolling a replacement when other devices are gone. On 4 November 2026 the owner also answered: "Yes, acknowledge only (Recommended)" for a phone acknowledging an incident, "Account recovery only (Recommended)" for what recovery covers on a phone, so replay, restore and pause stay on iPad or desktop, and "The purchase (Recommended)" for what lifts MP-164's bar. The rest of the live and off split is the maker's reading, open to the owner. control: named means the act is listed, and no admin screen draws it yet. Nothing here approves a design or a build.
